about: docs/structure.md. `valid`: a view body and the DOM it must become, serialised as the page does (tags lower case, attributes sorted, double quotes, no whitespace between tags): checked in Chromium by scripts/check-structure.js and, when it exists, by the prerenderer. `refusals`: a view body (or a whole program) and the rule tag that refuses it: checked by cargo test.
